limitations: Requests are native GET reads, two reviewed fixture-preview POST operations, and private sign-in/exact-session sign-out POSTs.
Only native default views are visited. The two reviewed fixture-preview POSTs render samples only; no filter, fault, payment, provider, hardware or business mutation is dispatched.
This checks two default-view responses, not every filter, total, workflow or possible data state. No screenshots or raw DOM text are saved.
Native read endpoints may create their ordinary read-audit entries. No business mutation request is dispatched.

Only two native default pages are visited. Exact preview fetch responses are cloned and measured before the unchanged original Response is returned; no mocked/replaced data or new business action is used.

Image/font/media display stays suppressed by the reviewed policy. Passive native blob-image dimensions are recorded, but an image blocked by privacy is not evidence that the API PNG was empty. No screenshots or raw payloads/PNG bytes are saved.

The clone measurement adds a bounded wait before returning the original Response. Application response.blob() size is not patched or measured directly; only the clone bytes and passive native image dimensions are observed.
Diagnostic completion is separate from defaultViewClean/fullAuditComplete. Original seven empty observer reads and response validation are not waived.

Declared supported JSON schemas are checked using existing Fastify Ajv dependencies. Unsupported or missing schemas are explicit limitations, never reported as matches. This helper does not certify every workflow or asset-byte closure.
completeMeaning: Two-page diagnostic observations settled and authority/deployment/cleanup guards passed; this is not the full audit or a waiver of any failed PNG/schema observation.
